root_cause.text: The `bpf_core_parse_spec()` function lacks validation to reject negative CO-RE accessor indices, enabling them to bypass upper-bound checks due to signed/unsigned integer promotion.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states `sscanf("%d")` silently accepts negative values and existing bounds checks (`access_idx >= btf_vlen(t)`) fail for negatives due to C integer promotion; the patch fixes this by adding `if (access_idx < 0) return -EINVAL;` immediately after parsing.
